title: Renaissance Airplane Travel Necktie, World Map - Pre-owned
descriptionText:
Elevate your style with this stunning Renaissance Global Airplane Travel Tie. Made with high-quality polyester material, this tie features a beautiful geometric pattern in multicolor that is sure to catch everyone's attention. The tie's classic length and width make it a perfect fit for any occasion, while the vintage design adds a touch of sophistication.

This handmade tie from Museo is a must-have for any fashion-forward man who loves to travel and appreciates the beauty of vehicles and transportation. The tie is from Korea, Republic of, and was manufactured between 1990-1999. With its unique theme of travel and transportation, this tie is perfect for any occasion. Add it to your wardrobe today and make a statement wherever you go.
